correctness.rationale: Greedy earliest-embedding lemma gives one canonical deletion mask per distinct subsequence; 3-state right-to-left transfer and 9-state paired tensor transfer give an exact rational resolvent. With numerator degree 4, denominator degree 5, 9-state determinant degree <=9, adjugate degree <=8, the difference numerator has degree <=13. A standalone exact-rational polynomial computation verifies every monomial in the first 14 u-coefficients is zero. Independent ordinary deletion-mask enumeration through length 8 and an independent all-length polynomial verification of the three-deletion first/second moments, with word enumeration through length 13, corroborate the theorem. Variance polynomial and dominant pole are exact algebraic consequences.

value.rationale: The complete rational all-radius mixed second-moment enumerator is a natural information-theoretic invariant, furnishing covariances at arbitrary distinct deletion radii. Its explicit variance for radius three reveals n^(5/2) fluctuations, and its total-subsequence specialization exhibits exponential relative variance rather than the mean-only behavior previously quantified. The theorem is not a table lookup, trivial reparameterization or arbitrary finite slice.
